title: Intelligence activity on Native American lands (The Octopus Murders)

tellings.quote: You actually you could watch a really popular Netflix show right now called The Octopus Murders.

plain: Intelligence work is said to have gone on quietly on Native American reservations, and a company called Wackenhut is named in connection with it. Michels raises this himself and points listeners to The Octopus Murders, a popular Netflix series, as a place to see it laid out. He gives few details, but the suggestion is that reservations served as places where secret activity could happen out of sight.
